7.description: [Reaching Recovery] Now reduces the initial heal of Chain heal by 3% and increases the subsequent jumps by 5% from 7% and 10% respectively.
[Compound Power] Increased the bleed damage dealt by Combo Shot by 50%.
[Compound Power] Increased the damage of Combo shot from 108% weapon damage to 150% weapon damage.
[Compound Power] Steady shot and Arcane shot now grant 2 combo points per hit, they no longer requires critical strikes.
[Lucifur] - Fixed an issue where the dot from Charred Bite was not scaling with SP and AP.
[Lucifur] - Mark of the Beast now grants haste and damage instead of spell critical strike chance and damage.
[Lucifur] - Shred and Mangle now procs Devil's Claw on all targets struck, when affected by the Devil's Claw buff.
[Lucifur] - Whilst effected by the lowered GCD buff, when entering Cat Form you cast Cataclysm.

[Lucifur] [New] - [Cataclysm] - Lucifur now teaches you Cataclysm. Cataclysm is an AoE spell that deals large fire damage to up to 6 nearby enemy targets within 8 yard range and applies a fire damage over time debuff to targets effected. Casting this grants you 15% increased fire damage. Only useable in Cat Form. +

[Lucifur] [New] - [Number of the Beast] - Critically Striking with any abiliy has a 66% chance to grant you Number of the Beast, stacking 6 times. Upon reaching 6 stacks you can manually cast Cataclysm consuming all stacks and granting an additional 7 seconds of Devil's Claw.

[Lucifur] [New] - [Devil's Ignition] - Your Incinerate is transformed in to Devil's Ingition, dealing fire damage and additional damage if the target is effected by Charred Bite instead of Immolate. Critically Striking with Mangle, Claw or Shred has a chance to grant you Devil's Ember allowing you to cast Devil's Ignition. Only usable in Cat Form.
[Lucifur] - Charred Bite now increases the damage dealt by Searing Pain and Devil's Ignition by 10% per stack.
[Lucifur] - Searing Pain has reduced threat generation whilst you have Lucifur equipped.
[Lucifur] - The Devil's Claw generator for Lucifur has changed from Scorch to Searing Pain, and all related buffs and effects have been changed to affect Searing Pain instead.
[Eldritch Knight] - While Eldritch Weapon is active you generate 20% more threat overall. Eldritch Explosion now generates 30% more threat, 50% with the Eldritch Weapon buff.
[Curse of Arugal] - Void Eruption can now be used while shapeshifted into a Worgen.
[One with the Light] One with the Light now causes Holy Specialization to grant 10% cast time reduction for your Holy Fire, instead of granting % damage to Smite and Holy Fire.

[One with the Light] One with the Light has been changed slightly. It can now only trigger one instance of two stacks of Holy Specialization. (Before it was possible to trigger ten stacks instantaneously from a single Divine Storm, this caused major performance issues.)

[Repentant Reconcilliation] [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Repentant Reconcilliation would not be consumed when healing allies or damaging enemies. (It previously would only be consumed upon healing yourself.)
[Cauterizing Flames] [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Cauterizing Fire would gain double the effect of Divine Aegis. It will now correctly benefit the same as other Holy healing effects.

1.description: Chain heal jumps now heal for 75% of the original amount up from 60%. (These changes overall aim to reduce the reliance upon Tidal Force in both low gear scenarios and high gear scenarios respectively.)

Tidal Mastery is now a 3 point talent down from 5 points. (its cooldown per talent point has not changed. This results in a 12 second cooldown nerf to Tidal Force, from 1 minute to 1 minute 12 seconds.)
Tidal Force now causes healing wave to heal the target again for 30% of the original amount down from 40%.
Tidal Force now increases the healing of Chain heal jumps by 15% from 75% to 90%.
Holy Specialization now gives your Holy spell critical damage spells a chance to increase your magic damage done by 5%.

Holy Specialization has been Reworked slightly. It now no longer reduces the cast time of holy spells by 10% per stack. It's previous effect remains unchanged. (it still grants 3% critical strike chance for holy spells per stack.)

0.description: [Pending Restart] - A New Heirloom Shield has been added, Polished Observer's Shield, this shield has Stamina, Defense and Hit Rating. The armor of the shield will not currently reflect accurately in the tooltip, however, will display correctly when equipped by you, this behavior is denoted in the tooltip with an "equip" effect.

[Reposting For Clarity] - Originally TBC did not have Armor Penetration Gems. With the addition of new gems in this patch, Armor Penetration Gems can be obtained just like other Gem Recipes and can be crafted once you obtain the pattern.

[Pending Maintenance and Core Merge] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Anetheron] Corrected the visual scale of Lady Jaina's Ring of Frost to match the actual effect radius.

[Pending Maintenance and Core Merge] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Anetheron] Added raid warnings that announce who got send into the Nightmare.
[Pending Maintenance and Core Merge] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Anetheron] Extended Nightmare and Sleep tolltipps to further explain how the mechanic works.
[Pending Maintenance and Core Merge] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Anetheron] Increased the scale of players bodys that are send into the Nighhtmare by 100% for allied healers to spot them easier.

[Pending Maintenance and Core Merge] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Anetheron] Corrected an issue where player would not see Spiritual Pain appear on screen or their combat logs. Spiritual Pain will now correctly show up informing the player inside the Nightmare that he takes damage because of his left behind body taking damage as well.
[Pending Maintenance and Core Merge] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Anetheron] Player leaving or entering the Nightmare now get restored to full health.

[Pending Maintenance and Core Merge] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [Items] The tooltipps of Exquisit and Flawless Bands of Eternity now display their proc chance and internal cooldown.

[Pending Maintenance and Core Merge] [The Battle for Mount Hyjal] [General] Increased the time between waves spawning after the last invading creature of a wave has been killed to 15 seconds up from 5 seconds to grant player room for resurrection, buffing and regeneration.

2.description: [Area 52] Heroic Bloodforged events can now drop all previous tiers without an event scroll active. Event Scrolls will still be required to obtain the most recent Heroic Bloodforged tier gear. That means with Hyjal released previous tiers like Karazhan or Serpentshrine Cavern will drop Heroic Bloodforged from the Event Areas even without a scroll active. As a note: Heroic Bloodforged Hyjal requires 145 ilvl to obtain.
